_comment: Model roles and prices for model_benchmark.py, in dollars per million tokens. The notebook's own ids and prices are in the notebook (cell 7). notebook_cost always uses the notebook's fixed multipliers (cache write 1.25x for 5 minutes and 2x for 1 hour, cache read 0.10x). list_cache_read_mult is per model id and feeds a second, list-price cost column only.
_roles_note: The roles hold the ids a run used. Check each id against the models your key can call before a paid run; model_benchmark.py does not probe them.
_haiku_note: As in the notebook (cell 15, 'Haiku takes neither thinking nor effort'), the haiku role never sends thinking or output_config, whatever id fills it.
